about: Game facts and tool-use lessons from earlier seated games. One entry per note; notes.py validates the file and serves it through discover(what='notes').

topics.claims: read first: turn-one vetoes, claims, armies, minting
topics.war: declaring and ending wars: prices, allies, refusals
topics.economy: gold: income, what drains it, windfalls
topics.prestige: prestige: the start drain, what it blocks
topics.tools: reading replies, refusals and idle turns

notes.text: Before step 1: do ai_veto what=spending, or the AI buys: laws, legacies (renown), hires, regiments, builds, vassalage, activities, gold/income decisions, titles other than your goal and those it needs, culture (culture_conversion_ahead).
notes.provenance: seated games of the Ireland starts: the AI bought d_meath, k_ireland, a mercenary company, a mangonel; crown authority 143 (1066) and 792 (867, 89 counties) prestige: 00_law_values.txt; ai_veto dropped such posts live

notes.text: A fabricated claim dies with your ruler unless pressed: a war on it presses it, white peace too. Declare on each claim once it arrives, but not in debt: below 0 gold no war is allowed.
notes.provenance: game localization game_concept_unpressed_claim_desc and game_concept_pressed_claim_desc; seated games of the 1066 Ireland start (claims lost at the founder's death in three); declare_war_interaction is_in_debt = no (00_war.txt)

notes.text: Raised armies make the game refuse a war declaration, for as long as they stand; its AI raises them, at peace too. Disband first (cbs names the call); refused near another ruler's army, wherever: move away, hold, disband.
notes.provenance: game file common/character_interactions/00_war.txt; a seated game of the 1066 Ireland start (1,680 men raised at peace); live army runs on the 1066 save; the disband check counts hostile units in the army's and the next counties

notes.text: Mint a duchy yourself once you control half its counties (formable_titles prices it): +300 prestige, +25 legitimacy; then a claim war on a count costs a duke x1.25, at low legitimacy x2 (a count x1.5). De jure wars pay neither.
notes.provenance: game files 00_defines.txt CREATE_TITLE_PRESTIGE_GAIN and _LEGITIMACY_GAIN; game_concept_duchy_desc (at least half its counties); 99_casus_belli_values.txt (x1.25); 00_claim.txt; 00_dejure_war.txt

notes.text: A county claim costs (40 - chaplain learning) x 3 gold (x2 in some struggles), at least a random 40-60, paid when you take the letter (0301 or 0302: rule both), even below 0 gold; declining is free.
notes.provenance: game files common/script_values/99_court_chaplain_values.txt (county_cost) and events/councillor_task_events/court_chaplain_task_events.txt (0301, 0302); measured 65-107 gold on 15 claims; a 0302 letter paid into debt

notes.text: A war on your own claim costs prestige at the declare: per title 100 a county, 200 a duchy, 400 a kingdom, 800 an empire, a quarter less pressed, times multipliers (x1.25 vs another faith). cbs prices claim_cb.
notes.provenance: game file common/script_values/99_casus_belli_values.txt; a live reading at 1067.11.27 (-125.00); two seated games of the 1066 Ireland start

notes.text: The defender's allies join his war: a foreign king who joins can decide a claim war. Read cbs defender_allies and compare strength before declaring.
notes.provenance: a seated game of the 1066 Ireland start (1070 and 1088); a neighbouring duke joined in another (1086)

notes.text: Yielding a claim or de jure war you started costs 3 years of your income in gold (x2 against some cultures) as well as prestige; winning one as attacker pays no gold. Read end_war's check before yielding.
notes.provenance: the casus belli's on_defeat effect (game files); measured -243, -176 and -67 gold in seated games of the 1066 Ireland start; end_war check priced -113.4 live

notes.text: A king can force you into vassalage only while your realm holds at most 4 + 3 per war innovation of his culture counties; more counties or a kingdom title closes it. inspect threats reads each one's limit now.
notes.provenance: game files casus_belli_types vassalization_cb and the vassalization size limit value; a seated game of the 1066 Ireland start: a king vassalized a 3-county count (1084-85)

notes.text: A chaplain fabricating non-stop costs about what a small realm earns: over decades the claims can take nearly all its net gold. A duchy and the kingdom are paid from gold saved while he idles or from windfalls (prices: formable_titles).
notes.provenance: a seated game of the 1066 Ireland start (purse by cause); title prices read on day one

notes.text: The head of faith's gold pays 18 months of income (at least 100) for 250 piety, once in 3 years. He refuses while you attack a ruler of your faith (-50 on a base of -40). discover acceptance lists his terms.
notes.provenance: game files common/character_interactions/00_religious_interactions.txt, common/script_values/01_dynamic_values.txt; a seated game of the 1066 Ireland start

notes.text: The game's AI answers your events and may spend gold (a stress pick: 50 or more). Set event_rule on a stress event news names to a non-gold option.
notes.provenance: a seated game of the 1066 Munster start: stress_threshold.1731 answered profligate by the AI (about -95 gold, 1093) and bishop.2002 (about -23, 1095), both in the purse as unexplained

notes.text: With no seat act, the AI can raise crown authority at once ((100 + 10 a realm county) x his learning's factor; ai_veto law stops it), and prestige can fall from causes no read names: keep a margin over a war's price.
notes.provenance: identical in every seated game of the 1066 Ireland start and in a live reading with no seat action; the realm laws read before and after

notes.text: Prestige rises slowly at peace (observe's prestige_monthly is the rate); a war won as attacker gives fame, not prestige; a claim war's yield costs 10 x the war's prestige factor. Below a war's price the declare is refused.
notes.provenance: three seated games of the 1066 Ireland start

notes.text: Your AI accepts guest invitations (a coronation can last months) and no declaration passes until it ends: do host_activity activity=leave.
notes.provenance: game file common/character_interactions/00_war.txt (involved_activity); seated games of the 1066 Munster start: a coronation as guest blocked declarations nine turns, and a kingdom claim war until the ruler died

notes.text: An ally who joins a war you attack in costs you prestige: 75 a count, 150 a duke, 350 a king. A call to a war you defend is free. ai_veto ally_call stops the AI's calls, not yours.
notes.provenance: game file common/scripted_effects/00_interaction_effects.txt (call_ally_interaction_event_effect); seated games of the 1066 Ireland start: -73 when a count joined; a king called in 1070 (prestige 413 to -48, no claim war until 1075)

notes.text: At a succession the heir's own prestige and piety replace the old ruler's (either can move by several hundred, up or down), and the old ruler's unpressed claims are gone.
notes.provenance: two seated games of the 1066 Ireland start (1080, 1091)

notes.text: Under partition your land is split among your living eligible children (sons first under male preference); a duke's younger sons take duchies he holds or the law creates, and leave. A count's son given a county leaves too.
notes.provenance: game localization partition_base_desc and game_concept eligible children; seated games of the 1066 Ireland start: a son took 2 of 5 counties and left the realm (1082); a grandchild and a brother read as heirs took nothing

notes.text: A son who takes vows (350 piety for your child; he may refuse) or is disinherited (a share's heir: 300 prestige, 150 renown x the era factor; you must head the dynasty) takes no share. succession_plan prices both; act early.
notes.provenance: game files take_vows_interaction, ask_to_take_vows_piety_cost, disinherit_interaction and the dynasty renown values (early medieval x2); a live game: disinherit took 150 prestige at the send, a son refused vows; a seated game's death at 56

notes.text: A kingdom's de jure share counts counties held by your vassals; a duke's or king's grant to a vassal keeps the county counted.
notes.provenance: the game's title-creation rule; a seated game of the 1066 Ireland start (Oriel granted to a vassal stayed counted)

notes.text: Holding a duchy title opens a de jure war on each of its counties held by others: no claim, no fabrication gold, 100 prestige times multipliers (needs the casus belli innovation).
notes.provenance: game files (individual_county_de_jure_cb, common/casus_belli_types)

notes.text: No fabrication on a living parent's county: the game counts it as your claim. A sibling's or child's county is fine.
notes.provenance: live 1066: the game's own check refused 10 of 10 counties a parent holds and accepted 28 of 30 a sibling or child holds (the 2 others: explicit claims); c_leinster set by script was reset within 15 days

notes.text: Set diplomacy_foreign_affairs_focus and ai_veto perk (or the AI spends them); thoughtful_perk then ducal_conquest_perk: no-claim wars on adjacent counties of uncreated duchies you hold a county in, 50 prestige as a count, 100 above.
notes.provenance: game files common/lifestyles/00_lifestyles.txt (base_xp_gain 25, xp_per_level 1000), lifestyle_perks/00_diplomacy_1_foreign_affairs_tree_perks.txt, casus_belli_types/00_conquest.txt (50 a count); live: the AI's pick dropped under the veto

notes.text: observe's idle block names what is not running (no fabrication, claims with no war). Read it before ending a turn with no call: a claim with no war, or a chaplain with no task, waits for one.
notes.provenance: two seated games of the 1066 Ireland start (75 bare turns of 150; 101 of 150)

notes.text: 'The game gives no detail' means the game's own check said no after the tool's checks passed; resending it unchanged is answered from memory. Read checked_before_sending, then change target, arguments or date.
notes.provenance: four seated games of the 1066 Ireland start (declares, invitations, grants)

notes.text: The game's AI answers a faction's demand for your ruler unless you answer first (granting a populist demand can cost every title): do faction respond_demand refuse, or an event_rule.
notes.provenance: a seated game of the 1066 Ireland start (1079.11.13: faction_demand.1001 answered grant independence by the AI); levers: do intent faction respond_demand, event_rule (the faction letter's event)

notes.text: A marriage or betrothal of close kin of two rulers makes them allies. Without one, a defender's allies can decide your wars.
notes.provenance: game localization game_concept_alliance_desc; 00_defines.txt MAX_ALLIANCE_FAMILY_DISTANCE_SUM; three seated games of the 1066 Ireland start (no marriage sent; claim wars lost after a king joined the defender)

notes.scope: seats whose turns end with a notes pad
notes.text: The end_turn pad is the next turn's only memory: plan, claims, vetoes. A birth can split a partition: run succession_plan after each. At 8 counties, 2 duchy titles and the gold: do intent=mint_title args.title_key=k_ireland.
notes.provenance: three seated games of the 1066 Ireland start: the one holder read was taken at turn 1 and not again for 15-23 game years; the bare mint_title call created k_ireland live from a saved game (12/14 counties, 325 gold)

notes.text: do convert_faith to the local faith converts your ruler at once for no piety; a claim war on a county of that faith then costs 100 prestige, not 125 (the other-faith x1.25 is gone), and its holder's opinion of you rises.
notes.provenance: a short live game, 1067.11-1068.01: piety 444.8 then 447.2; the declaration took 99 prestige; opinion -16 to -1, the -30 claim modifier unchanged; Catholic opinion not read; 99_casus_belli_values.txt

notes.text: A war's end, white peace too, usually bars its attacker from declaring on that defender for 1825 days (less with the flexible truces perk); see cbs. A claim or de jure war's white peace costs its attacker 5 x the war's prestige factor.
notes.provenance: game files 00_war_values.txt and 00_war_effects.txt; three refusals in a seated game of the 1066 Ireland start; a live white peace, prestige 287.89 -> 280.39

notes.text: At Dublin (Norse) an Irish ruler's AI converts to Norse for 1000 prestige before its multipliers once able (convert_to_local_culture_decision); ai_veto decision stops it.
notes.provenance: a seated game of the 1066 Ireland start: -1000 in one month of 1087, the ruler's culture irish then norse; the decision's cost block in the game files

ireland1066.about: Murchad, Count of Dublin, 1066: hold k_ireland (also the Ireland decision starts and the Munster task that ends at the first holding)

francia867.about: Charles, King of West Francia, 867: hold e_france

add.text: Before step 1: do ai_veto what=spending. Unvetoed, a king's AI can raise crown authority ((100 + 10 a realm county) x his learning's factor) and change the court type (500) in a day (no war below 0 prestige), and spends renown.
add.provenance: Three scripted games at 867.01.01, prestige read daily: 986.67 to -305.33 on 0867.03.23; the court-type command named in query_ai_veto; legacies: a seated game of the 867 start, bought 867.04 and 885.10

add.text: e_france needs over 80% of its de jure counties in your realm, its gold price and two kingdom titles (formable_titles reads both). Create it before your death: partition sends Aquitaine's counties out; created first, it stays.
add.provenance: The game's creation check read at 867.01.01 (89 of 94, 850 gold); game_concepts 'more than 80%'; succession_plan's partition forecast

add.text: k_sweden needs at least half of its 25 de jure counties in your realm (13; vassals count) and two duchy titles: mint a second duchy you hold half of first. A tribal ruler pays half the gold for a title.
add.provenance: de jure 12 of 25 read at 867.01.01; the at-least-half rule and CREATE_TITLE_OR_TIER_KINGDOM; tribal title_creation_cost_mult -0.5

add.text: A tribal ruler's men-at-arms cost prestige, not gold, and its AI raids at peace for gold and prestige; a raised army blocks a declaration. Tribal subjugation needs prestige level 2 (1 with some cultures) against a tribal ruler.
add.provenance: Tribal men-at-arms bought for prestige at 867 (60 listed, 54 charged); 00_subjugation.txt prestige_level 2; raid flag read on a live game
